reconcile.note: Henry treats the centurion's two confessions as one testimony, since calling Jesus righteous already affirms what calling him Son of God claims.

sides.snippet: Truly this man was the Son of God!
sides.verseText: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, \"Truly this man was the Son of God!\"

sides.snippet: Certainly this was a righteous man.
sides.verseText: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, \"Certainly this was a righteous man.\"
